detail.longDescription: I am interested in understanding how Python can help automate technical drawing documentation in CAD workflows. In drafting projects, tasks such as generating drawing lists, updating dimensions, organizing drawing files, creating revision logs, and extracting information from drawings can take considerable time when done manually. Can Python be used to automate these tasks? Which Python libraries or CAD APIs would be useful for working with CAD files such as DXF or DWG? I would appreciate suggestions, practical examples, or guidance on getting started.
